purpose: Identify every active current-route script that owns, wraps, intercepts, or delegates Resident Run behavior.

residentRun_owners_and_wrappers.role: Original Resident Run implementation inside base app.
residentRun_owners_and_wrappers.behavior: Reads #ask and #paste, lowercases request, writes user chat, routes by local regex/templates, creates manual ChatGPT handoff for unmatched/deeper reasoning.
residentRun_owners_and_wrappers.intercepts: general Resident requests after outer wrappers delegate

residentRun_owners_and_wrappers.role: Wraps residentRun once using win.__pmpResidentXRayCorePatched guard.
residentRun_owners_and_wrappers.behavior: Calls buildXRay('resident_run_before_answer') before delegating to previous residentRun.
residentRun_owners_and_wrappers.intercepts: all Resident Run calls, but only adds X-Ray context; does not consume normal request unless no oldRun exists.

residentRun_owners_and_wrappers.role: Wraps residentRun once using w.__pmpResidentLosslessReadinessRunPatched guard and adds Run capture listener.
residentRun_owners_and_wrappers.behavior: If the question asks lossless readiness/check/quality or copy lossless in Resident, builds readiness report and writes #residentReply/#residentWork plus pmp_resident_lossless_readiness_latest_v1. Otherwise delegates to oldRun.

residentRun_owners_and_wrappers.role: Wraps residentRun once using w.__copyLosslessDiagRun guard and adds Run/Show Work/Copy Work capture listeners.
residentRun_owners_and_wrappers.behavior: If the question includes diagnose + copy + lossless, builds diagnostic report and writes #residentReply/#residentWork plus pmp_copy_lossless_diagnostic_v1. Otherwise delegates to oldRun.

not_residentRun_owners.role: Injects support scripts, patches route/control functions, installs Deep Resident overlay, but does not directly replace residentRun.
Patches showWork and copyWork and adds Show Work/Copy Work capture listeners; does not replace residentRun.
Patches copyCurrent/copyLosslessReport and copy buttons; does not replace residentRun.
Top-shell lossless packet/copy button system; does not replace residentRun.
Add private source intake, claim controls, phase proof surfaces, and local receipts; no direct residentRun replacement found in audited snippets.

bounded_final_chain.normal_request: Final active residentRun wrapper, whichever patch ran last, delegates through older wrappers until original v6 residentRun handles normal local rules/templates/handoff.
bounded_final_chain.lossless_readiness_request: Run capture listener or readiness wrapper may consume request before base v6 and write readiness report.
bounded_final_chain.diagnose_copy_lossless_request: Run capture listener or diagnostic wrapper may consume request before base v6 and write diagnostic report.
bounded_final_chain.xray_effect: X-Ray wrapper refreshes safe context before delegated answers when its wrapper is in the active chain.
bounded_final_chain.show_copy_work_effect: Work-fix may override Show Work/Copy Work behavior but does not own Run.

important_unknowns_reduced: The list of active current-route residentRun wrappers is now bounded to X-Ray, Lossless Readiness, and Copy Lossless Diagnostic plus original v6.
The current-inner control shell is not a direct residentRun owner.
Work-fix is not a Run owner; it is a Show/Copy Work owner.
remaining_watch: Exact live runtime order among wrappers remains inferred from script order, intervals, and setTimeout timing, not browser-executed here.
Because wrappers capture oldRun at patch time and run on repeated intervals, live order should be proven by a runtime trace if PASS without watch is required.
The bounded chain is sufficient for Packet 03 because all wrappers either delegate or consume only narrow diagnostic/readiness commands and none adds AI model reasoning or promotion authority.
safe_claim: Resident Run ownership is bounded for the corrected current route: original v6 residentRun handles normal requests; X-Ray, Lossless Readiness, and Copy Lossless Diagnostic are the active Run wrappers/interceptors; other injected scripts do not directly own residentRun based on audited evidence.
do_not_claim: Exact live patch order is runtime-proven.
All browser timing behavior is proven without live execution.
Resident has repository write, promotion, rollback, or validator authority.
